title: 穿越梦境迷宫
prompt: [Character] sprinting past dream elements, Storybook illustration, Maze of floating doors, clocks, and whispers, Lantern glow and ambient sparkle trails, [Color1] and [Color2], Whimsical and fast-paced, Follow-cam style with trailing POV
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作奇幻故事书风格的插画，适合打造充满漂浮元素和光影氛围的梦境角色场景，为书籍封面或动画概念注入魔法般的视觉魅力。
